# doctui

Generated component and package reference for doctui 0.0.0.

## Packages

- @doctui/core: Core Vue components, theme and primitives.
- @doctui/hooks: Reusable Vue composables for browser and app state.
- @doctui/form: Vue-first form state, validation and submit helpers.
- @doctui/notifications: Notification store and accessible renderer.
- @doctui/dates: Dependency-free date and calendar components.
- @doctui/mcp-server: Local MCP server for querying the generated registry.

## Components

- ActionIcon (@doctui/core): Compact icon-only native button with an accessible name.
- Autocomplete (@doctui/core): Searchable single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
- Badge (@doctui/core): Compact status label using semantic color and variant tokens.
- Box (@doctui/core): Low-level polymorphic container with token-based spacing.
- Button (@doctui/core): Native button control with doctui color, variant and size tokens.
- Calendar (@doctui/dates): Accessible token-driven month grid with adjacent-month days, range constraints and keyboard navigation.
- Center (@doctui/core): Flex helper that centers content on both axes.
- Checkbox (@doctui/core): Native checkbox semantics with doctui-controlled visual geometry and shared field messaging.
- Code (@doctui/core): Monospace inline or block code presentation.
- Combobox (@doctui/core): Focus-managed listbox engine used by doctui selection controls.
- Container (@doctui/core): Centered responsive container constrained by theme breakpoints.
- DateInput (@doctui/dates): Native date field that reuses doctui core field geometry, sizing and validation states.
- DatePicker (@doctui/dates): Doctui-styled readonly date field with day, month and year picker views in one accessible dialog surface.
- DateTimePicker (@doctui/dates): Custom doctui date-time field combining the shared day/month/year picker with explicit hour and minute controls.
- Divider (@doctui/core): Separator for related content with optional label content.
- Drawer (@doctui/core): Accessible side dialog with shared overlay, nested-layer dismissal and focus restoration.
- Flex (@doctui/core): Flexbox layout primitive with theme-token gaps.
- Grid (@doctui/core): CSS grid layout primitive with token-backed gaps and columns.
- Group (@doctui/core): Horizontal wrapping layout for related controls and content.
- InputWrapper (@doctui/core): Shared label, description, required and error structure for inputs.
- Kbd (@doctui/core): Semantic keyboard shortcut label.
- Loader (@doctui/core): Animated progress indicator for an indeterminate operation.
- Menu (@doctui/core): Keyboard-navigable menu built from native menu item buttons.
- Modal (@doctui/core): Accessible modal dialog with nested-layer dismissal, reference-counted scroll lock and focus restoration.
- MonthPicker (@doctui/dates): Keyboard-navigable month listbox rendered in the shared doctui date surface.
- MultiSelect (@doctui/core): Searchable multi-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
- Notifications (@doctui/notifications): Accessible renderer for notifications managed by a store.
- NumberInput (@doctui/core): Native numeric input with numeric v-model values and range constraints.
- Overlay (@doctui/core): Portal-backed semantic-color backdrop with controlled visibility and dismissal.
- Paper (@doctui/core): Surface container with optional border, radius and shadow.
- PasswordInput (@doctui/core): Password field built on the shared TextInput contract.
- Popover (@doctui/core): Dismissable contextual panel anchored to a target slot.
- Radio (@doctui/core): Native radio option with doctui-controlled visual geometry for a shared scalar v-model.
- SegmentedControl (@doctui/core): Single-selection control with radio semantics and arrow navigation.
- Select (@doctui/core): Single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox focus model.
- Skeleton (@doctui/core): Loading placeholder that can reveal its content when ready.
- Space (@doctui/core): Semantic layout spacer using the theme spacing scale.
- Stack (@doctui/core): Vertical flex layout for consistent spacing between children.
- Switch (@doctui/core): Boolean toggle that keeps native checkbox behavior behind a doctui track and thumb visual.
- TagsInput (@doctui/core): Free-form token field with deterministic parsing, native focus and accessible token-list semantics.
- Text (@doctui/core): Semantic text primitive using doctui typography and color tokens.
- Textarea (@doctui/core): Multi-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
- TextInput (@doctui/core): Single-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
- Title (@doctui/core): Semantic h1-h6 heading primitive.
- Tooltip (@doctui/core): Non-essential contextual text revealed on hover or focus.
- UnstyledButton (@doctui/core): Native button reset for building custom action surfaces.
- YearPicker (@doctui/dates): Keyboard-navigable paged year listbox with previous/next range navigation in the shared doctui date surface.
